ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between the light central interior (white and tan) and the low-intensity black trailing edge and notch margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant large, irregular tan/brownish blob on the right lobe; scattered smaller tan focal spots on the left lobe; continuous black pigmentation band approximately 10-20 pixels wide along the entire trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-5 pixel depth) across the central trailing edge, transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks (10+ pixels) at the lateral lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve along the posterior boundary of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast dark circular spots clustered on the interior of the left lobe; white calcified clusters visible on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint dark linear disruptions visible on the upper lateral region of the left lobe and near the right interior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Barnacle encrustation present at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive tan/ochre pigmentation overlaying roughly 45% of the white ventral surface area.
